task: Calculate the average company revenue for the years 2010 to 2019 from '/testbed/data/company_revenues.xlsx' and generate a summary word document named 'revenue_summary_2010_2019.docx' with the following contents: a title 'Revenue Summary (2010-2019)', a paragraph reporting the calculated average revenue for this period, and a clear mention of the years included in the calculation. Do not include any other years' data. Ensure the document is newly created, not appended to any existing document.
query_sentence: Produce a summary document with the average revenue for the years 2010 to 2019.

ground_truth_memory.note: The summary must only cover years 2010 to 2019.
